SELECT sido.region_code, sido.region_name, SUM(statistics.damage_house_count) AS damage_house_count, #{baseDate} AS base_date FROM regions sido
LEFT JOIN regions sigungu ON sigungu.parent_region_id = sido.region_id AND sigungu.region_level = 'SIGUNGU'
LEFT JOIN fraud_damage_statistics statistics ON statistics.region_id = sigungu.region_id AND statistics.base_date = #{baseDate}
WHERE sido.region_level = 'SIDO'
GROUP BY sido.region_id, sido.region_code, sido.region_name
ORDER BY sido.region_code
